grid_rules.description: Each occupied floor section has one backtick at the center of its inclusive 5x3 glyph footprint. Adjacent sections share their outside edge.
grid_rules.mask_semantics: Each # is one usable floor section and possible character position.

room_shell_rules.description: A rectangular room has one more repeated north-wall span than usable floor-section centers.
The east wall is a recessed three-glyph projection: inner |, alternating / or space face, and outer |.

notes: Promote only approved recurring corrections into this file.
Keep full one-off target artwork in style_samples/targets.

occlusion_rules.description: Logical entities remain assigned to floor sections even when a projected foreground wall occupies the same screen character. Opaque mode keeps the wall glyph; x-ray mode replaces it with a dim entity glyph.

covered_section_centers.west_foreground_wall: none for a one-character centered entity in this fixture

composite_modes.opaque: retain wall glyph and mark the entity hidden
composite_modes.xray: replace wall glyph with a dim or gray entity glyph while retaining wall metadata

occlusion_rules.open_question: Confirm whether the provisional south row is walkable and whether wider sprites should be clipped by the west wall face.
